reconstruction_summary: Imported agent's predict.py which loads per-platform (L_eff, K_us, delta_offset, tau) from coeffs.json and applies steady-state bicycle yr_ss = v*(delta-d0)/(L_eff + K_us*v^2) with first-order lag toward yr_ss.
notes: baselines reproduce cached values; per-platform steady-state bicycle with first-order lag (delta_offset, L_eff, K_us, tau) loaded from coeffs.json — Ford-only platforms covered, both reduce yaw and CTE materially
